**Notes**
Kura's core rules are deliberate and unlikely to change: stable
`/Game/_AssetLib` paths (no custom import destinations), one entry per path
(no side-by-side versions), and validate-don't-move ingest. Requests that
work *with* those rules have a much better chance.
